title: Zesty Pillowy Malaysian Trout Satay
description: A festive Malaysian dish featuring rainbow trout, soffritto-base, and kosher-friendly ingredients, with a floral and pillowy texture. This dish is perfect for special occasions and outdoor gatherings.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Thread the trout pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the satay hot with the zesty sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with sliced fresh herbs, such as cilantro or scallions, if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers promptly and consume within a day.
To reheat, grill or bake the satay until heated through.
